jobs.name: pre-merge-review
jobs.command: claude -p "Review the changed files against ci/review-criteria.md" --output-format json --json-schema ci/review.schema.json --max-turns 8 --allowedTools "Read,Grep,Glob"

jobs.name: test-generation
jobs.command: claude -p "Write tests as described in ci/testgen-prompt.md" --output-format json --max-turns 6 --allowedTools "Read,Glob,Edit"
